newsitem.title: USA: Dental Services names Henry Ewen CFO.
newsitem.headline: Dental Services names Henry Ewen CFO.

text.p: Dental Services Of America Inc said Monday it named Henry Ewen chief financial officer.
Over the past ten years, Ewen has been operating International Financial Management Systems (IFMS) and his own accounting practice, Dental Services said.
Through IMFS, Ewen advised domestic and international companies and offshore banks and mutual funds.
Dental Services was not immediately available to comment on who Ewen replaces.
Dental Services of America is a dental practice management company.
